filas.consulta: Demuestra que todo entero se factoriza en primos de forma única
filas.enunciado:
-- READING: unique factorization of natural numbers ≥ 1 into primes,
-- stated via Nat.factors and Nat.prod_factors / Nat.factors_unique
-- also: could be stated for ℤ using associates and irreducible elements, but ℕ.factors is the standard formalization
theorem unique_prime_factorization (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ∃ l : List ℕ, (∀ p ∈ l, Nat.Prime p) ∧ l.prod = n ∧
      (∀ l' : List ℕ, (∀ p ∈ l', Nat.Prime p) → l'.prod = n → l' ~ l) := by
  sorry
